description: The recipe for This computer (1.7.31). Empty here: the harness ships none. The company puts its own in the knowledge base, company/tools/computer.json, copied to computer.company.json by `harness company sync`: {"ca_bundle": {"host": <an outside address>, "proxy": "host:port"}, "tool_folders": [{"label": <the tool>, "hint": <where its folder is, in words>}]}. No secret and no path of the person's own: Get ready fills the CA bundle address and the proxy from it when the person has set none, and shows the hints beside the tool folders. Read by core/launchenv.py.
